Read-only."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Install · The five axes · Why it refuses to guess · Read-only by design · 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Update:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Then open **Settings → 洞察 / Insight**. No build step, no restart. The panel ships both halves: a hos"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"t plugin that collects the data and a browser plugin that draws it."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A running `dsh` profile is assembled from layers you never see side by side:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- each bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, market packages, your own plugins)
"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"- your profile's patch layer, `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`
- `$DSH_HOME/settings.yam"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"l` — legacy settings file from older dsh; 0.1.7 imports it once on first start and renames it to `se"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ttings.yaml.imported`, so it is listed only when present
- `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` and environ"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ported`, so it is listed only when present
- `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` and environment variables"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Which of it survives is decided by patch semantics (insert / update / disable, by id) and by what th"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e cordis loader actually managed to start. **No single file tells you the answer**, so "why isn't th"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"is plugin running" and "where did this model come from" turn into a hunt across four files and a run"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"time you cannot see."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"洞察 does that derivation for you, live, and shows its work."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## The six axes"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"One dataset, six ways to sort it. The first five are causal: **config produces plugins, plugins prov"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ide services, services register tools and models.** By preset comes last — it is not about what alre"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ady runs in this process but about a second configuration: the agent-plane one, mounted only when a "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"session starts. Switching axes never clears your selection."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 按配置 · By config — which layer wins"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Every config layer in application order, with what it did to the tree — `inserted 78`, `overrode 2`,"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" `disabled 24`. The first and last layers are marked, because a number alone never says which direct"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ion wins. Config files that take no part in the merge (the profile's `cordis.yml`, `settings.yaml`, "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"`.credentials.yaml`) are listed in the same table, marked as such — you usually want them for their "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"entials.yaml`) are listed in the same table, marked as such — you usually want them for their paths."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Pick a layer and the right pane names every entry it touched, each one a link into the plugin axis."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 按插件 · By plugin — the dossier"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The live loader tree — containers, nested realms, disabled entries folded away at the end of the lev"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"el they belong to. Select one and get its whole dossier:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Where it came from** — the layer that inserted it, its full entry id, its package and path on di"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"sk
- **Wiring** — services it provides and consumes, each with its counterpart; built-in host servic"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"es are named as such instead of showing up as a missing provider
- **Blast radius** — who depends on"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" it, transitively, so "what breaks if I turn this off" is a number and a list rather than a guess
- "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"**Its settings** — effective value, plugin default, and your override, side by side
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 按服务 · By service — what actually connects plugins"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Services are the real edges between plugins, so they get their own axis: who provides each one, how "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"many consume it, and — for a hub — the full impact list. This is a table and not a canvas on purpose"},{"id":"p25s3","text":": the dependency graph of a real profile is star-shaped, and a hub's edges cross the whole canvas no"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" matter which layout you pick."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### 按工具 · By tool — what the agent can actually call"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"One row per **tool name** — `bash`, `read`, `exit_plan_mode` — not per plugin. Each one carries the "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"package that registered it, its description, and how many sibling tools would disappear with it, bec"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ause turning a tool off means disabling the plugin that registers it."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Upstream records no registrant on a tool definition, and tools are not registered until an agent is "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"constructed. So this axis is assembled two ways and says which one it used: **observed at runtime** "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"(the panel listens in as registration happens and attributes it by call stack) or **inferred from so"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"urce** (a scan of the plugin's build output, marked as such — it can miss a name computed at runtime"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"). A request is open upstream for the field that would make the second path unnecessary."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Why it refuses to guess"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Most of the work in this plugin is in the cases where the honest answer is "I don't know", and sayin"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"g so instead of showing a plausible number:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Ambiguous short ids get no attribution.** The same short id can exist in two realms (`include:to"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ol-bash` and `include:agent-presets:tool-bash`). When a short id is not unique on both sides, the la"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"yer that inserted it is left blank rather than guessed.
- **Unevaluated expressions are not treated "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"as `false`.** `!!js` expressions in config survive replay as an opaque marker; they are excluded fro"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"m the drift report instead of being coerced to a boolean. Coercing them produced 22 false "this plug"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"in was disabled" reports before this was fixed.
- **Multiple candidate providers stay multiple.** Wh"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"en two plugins provide the same service name, the panel lists both instead of drawing a confident ed"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"ge to one.
- **Inferred data is labeled.** A tool name extracted from build output is marked `inferr"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"ed`; one observed at registration is not.
- **Settings with no plugin say so.** A settings namespace"},{"id":"p31s10","text":" whose owner cannot be identified is labeled as a settings namespace, not shown as a plugin with a b"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"lank package.
- **Version skew degrades, it does not break.** When the host process is older than th"},{"id":"p31s12","text":"e browser bundle (a rebuild without a restart), the summary is recomputed in the browser and says so"},{"id":"p31s13","text":", and an axis whose endpoint the host does not know yet stays empty with an explanation instead of t"},{"id":"p31s14","text":"urning the panel red."}],"truncated":true}
